seoTitle: C and C++ Code Re-indenter Online
metaDescription: Re-indent C or C++ by brace depth with 2 spaces, keep preprocessor lines at column 0, indent switch cases. No clang-format presets.
intro: Fixes indentation, blank lines and optionally line breaks in C and C++ code without sending it anywhere.
why:
Messy indentation hides the structure of C and C++ code, and minified or copy-pasted code is worse. A re-indenter gives you the block layout back quickly.

The tool reads your code with a small scanner that knows strings, comments and raw literals, so braces inside them are ignored. It then sets the indent from bracket depth and, if you ask, puts a line break after braces and semicolons. It is not clang-format.
howTo: Pick the indent and line break mode.
Use clang-format locally for a named style.

faq.q: Is this the same as clang-format?
faq.a: No. clang-format applies full style presets, wraps lines and aligns declarations. This tool re-indents and optionally breaks lines only, with no LLVM or Google preset.

faq.q: Will it change what my code does?
faq.a: It only changes whitespace outside strings, comments and raw literals. Test results: the non-whitespace text was unchanged on all test files, and re-running the tool gave the same output. Review the diff anyway.
Wrapping needs a full parser. This tool does not have one.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
